The plot illustrates three economic policy indices over time. The x-axis represents years, with a linear scale ranging from 2016 to 2025, and tick labels at yearly intervals. The left y-axis is labeled “Wirtschaftspolitik insgesamt (linke Skala)” and “Finanzpolitik (linke Skala)” and has a linear scale ranging from 0 to 1000, with tick labels at intervals of 100. The right y-axis is labeled “Handelspolitik (rechte Skala)” and has a linear scale ranging from 0 to 9, with tick labels at intervals of 1. 

The first line, representing “Wirtschaftspolitik insgesamt (linke Skala)”, is black and solid. It begins at approximately 100 in 2016, generally declines to a low of approximately 50 in 2019, then increases to a peak of approximately 500 in 2021, before declining to approximately 150 in 2024 and rising to approximately 250 in 2025. The second line, representing “Finanzpolitik (linke Skala)”, is blue and solid. It begins at approximately 100 in 2016, fluctuates between approximately 100 and 200 until 2020, then increases to approximately 300 in 2021, and declines to approximately 100 in 2025. The third line, representing “Handelspolitik (rechte Skala)”, is purple and solid. It begins at approximately 1 in 2016, fluctuates between approximately 1 and 2 until 2019, then increases to a peak of approximately 7 in 2021, and declines to approximately 1 in 2025.
